installCommand: sh -c 'curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf|sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain nightly-2025-01-07' && . $HOME/.cargo/env && sh -c 'curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf|sh' && cargo install just && corepack enable && yarn install
buildCommand: source "$HOME/.cargo/env" && just build && (cd packages/web-wallet && yarn build)
